name: @arena/read-model-service
description: The canonical read-model service for Arena (Work Order B005; issue #71): composes the B002 ControlPlaneRepository port with the pure @arena/read-model projections — readCanonical (typed RECORD_NOT_FOUND vs TENANT_SCOPE_VIOLATION; existence is never hidden across tenants), scrollByKind (deterministic (kind, recordId) ordering, bounded pages, opaque continuation tokens), listKinds (kind inventory with counts). READ-ONLY posture: the service exposes no mutation operations (asserted by hygiene tests) and takes the tenant from the B004-authenticated context, never from request payloads. The read model is a PROJECTION over canonical Arena objects, never a second authority: no state, no caching, every result re-read from the control plane carrying the source record's version + revision.
